body:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: modular cart BODY ONLY sprite sheet for ANIMOL Echo Theater.
Edit target: attached approved loaded-cart sheet. Keep its SAME four headings, cargo crate, folded burgundy curtain, cream scenery panel, brass trim, thick angular almost-black navy outlines, flat simple cel color masses. Keep the fixed 4 columns x2 rows and exactly the same cart design. Row0 headings S/E/N/W; row1 the same with forward padded bumper slightly compressed.
ONLY CHANGE: remove ALL WHEELS and wheel hardware hanging beyond the hull. Deliver eight isolated HULL + CARGO sprites with NO wheel circles, side-wheel lumps, axles, rail or floor. The lower hull must be clean and closed; do not make holes where wheels were. The removed wheels will be separate accurately positioned pieces.
Keep a square screen-aligned ground plan, upper-left light, warm walnut/ochre/cream/burgundy palette, crisp faceted shadow planes, no realistic rendering or gradients. Do not add an empty standing area or any passenger.
The hull should have a clear low bottom edge under the burgundy forward panel/bumper; no shadow below it. Preserve the cargo scale/alignment across the pairs and direction views. True transparent alpha background, clear gutters. No text, labels, arrows or extra objects.
hardware:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Production transparent MODULAR HARDWARE sheet for this ANIMOL theater rail cart. Match the attached cart's thick almost-black NAVY outline, flat ochre brass, walnut wood, burgundy/purple shadow planes, angular 2D cel cartoon style. No glossy 3D or gradients.
Exactly 3 columns x2 rows, SIX ISOLATED COMPONENTS with clear transparent gutters, no labels:
Top-left: one LEFT SIDE flanged cart wheel for a cart rolling NORTH/SOUTH. Thin vertical oval profile, dark navy iron tread, simple ochre hub, a clear inner retaining flange on its RIGHT edge. A visible flat tiny contact patch at bottom center; no ground or shadow.
Top-middle: the corresponding RIGHT SIDE north/south wheel, inner flange on its LEFT edge; same physical size and light from upper left.
Top-right: one NEAR/FORWARD wheel for an EAST/WEST cart. Chunky geometric circular/octagonal dark navy wheel with flat ochre central hub and distinct small inner rim. Clear contact patch at bottom center. No axle or other wheel attached.
Bottom-left: corresponding FAR/BACK east/west wheel, same actual size, slightly simplified front face but same outline and contact patch. No ground.
Bottom-middle: ONE straight horizontal WOODEN SLEEPER beam only, a long low rectangle with angular clipped corners, approximately length 8 times its thickness. Flat walnut base and one violet/navy lower-side shadow, two thin end bands allowed, no rails, plates, nails, gaps, supports or background.
Bottom-right: ONE top-down RAIL FASTENING SADDLE: a small dark navy rectangular mounting plate with a vertical EMPTY central channel, two simple ochre clamp blocks on left/right of that channel and two small cream bolt heads. The empty channel stays alpha transparent so the separate metal rail can pass through it. No wood or rail included.
Everything is a standalone sprite PART, not a scene. All 6 complete shapes are fully visible and centered, true RGBA transparency. No cart bodies, strings, arrows, text, decorative sparkles or extra components.
sleeper:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Create ONE railway WOODEN SLEEPER sprite in the flat angular style of the attached parts sheet. The existing lower-middle beam is much too thick; draw a NEW VERY THIN straight timber plank viewed from directly above.
The complete beam has a length-to-thickness ratio of approximately 12 to 1. It is a long low horizontal rectangle with slightly clipped corners, thick crisp near-black navy outline of consistent stroke weight, flat warm walnut top, ONE narrow polygonal muted violet shadow band, and two simple ochre reinforcing bands near the ends. No visible tall front wall or glossy 3D volume. No wood grain or gradients. It should read as a shallow railway sleeper, not a crate or log.
Only the ONE plank, no wheels, screws, plates, rail, labels, arrows, floor or cast shadow. Keep the full thin silhouette visible on a genuine transparent RGBA background, with generous clear space around it. Match the palette and angular cartoon linework of the reference.
geometry: Exact gauge/wheel contacts, native-profile mesh baking, global arc-length sleeper layout. Native color pixels are used as materials; no replacement art is painted procedurally.
